scope: Ten independent Chrome bridge connections on one computer with one saved device credential. Sequential connection preparation then concurrent final score/photo submission. Five-second non-overlapping board polling. No retries in measurement.
rankingControl: Synthetic per-zone times were 500ms to place this new batch ahead of earlier 1000ms test data. This changes ranking position only, not wall-clock latency. Preflight checked that no outside player would displace this batch.

limits: Not ten physical iPads, not a representative 95th percentile, not maximum-size photographs. This historical harness used a 30-second upload response timeout, while the real certificate page waits 60 seconds. Later harness revisions align that timeout; the 10-second performance target remains unchanged. Timeout alone does not prove server failure. All displayed burst executions were terminal before further work; certificate rows still need reconciliation before retries.
